What We Build

Websites engineered to be secure, scalable and pixel-perfect

DevEraXTech designs and builds business websites, online stores and high-conversion pages for companies, startups and creatives. Every project is treated as a long-term digital asset, engineered for resilience, elegant usability and growth.

  • Business / Corporate Websites

    Professional websites for companies, startups, agencies, shops, clinics, factories and schools, with home, about, services, team, portfolio and contact pages.

    Learn more →

  • E-Commerce Websites

    Online stores with product pages, a shopping cart, checkout, payment integrations and an admin dashboard.

    Learn more →

  • Shopify Stores

    Bespoke Shopify stores for premium brands, with designed product pages, a seamless cart, trusted payments and full store control.

    Learn more →

  • WordPress Websites

    Custom WordPress websites with responsive, high-performance layouts, secure plugins and easy content management.

    Learn more →

  • Portfolio Websites

    High-visual showcase websites for designers, photographers, developers and agencies.

  • Landing Pages
